Name: VSFTPD v2.3.4 Backdoor Command Execution
Synopsis: The remote FTP server contains a compromised backdoor module.
Description: The remote vsftpd daemon contains a backdoor opening a shell listener on port 6200 when a specific smiley face string is sent in the username.
Solution: Upgrade vsftpd to version 3.0.5 or replace with SFTP.

Name: Distcc Daemon Arbitrary Command Execution
Synopsis: The remote distcc daemon accepts unauthenticated compilation jobs.
Description: The remote daemon allows unauthenticated remote clients to execute arbitrary system commands via compilation calls.
Solution: Restrict distccd access using internal network access control lists or disable daemon.

Name: OpenSSL Heartbleed Information Disclosure
Synopsis: The remote OpenSSL service is affected by an information disclosure vulnerability.
Description: An attacker can read up to 64KB of process memory per heartbeat request, exposing keys and plaintext data.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.1g or higher and re-issue SSL certificates.

Name: DNS Server Zone Transfer (AXFR) Allowed
Synopsis: The remote DNS server allows unauthenticated zone transfers.
Description: The remote BIND server responds to AXFR queries, allowing unauthenticated attackers to retrieve the complete host directory.
Solution: Restrict transfer ACLs in named.conf.local using allow-transfer directive.

Name: Telnet Service Cleartext Authentication Enabled
Synopsis: The remote Telnet service transmits authentication credentials in cleartext.
Description: Remote management credentials sent to this port can be captured via packet sniffing.
Solution: Disable the telnet service and utilize SSH for remote administration.

Name: Apache Directory Indexing Enabled
Synopsis: Directory browsing is enabled on the web server.
Description: The remote web server returns index views for folders missing a default document.
Solution: Disable directory listing using Options -Indexes in Apache configuration.
